description: Ministry of Health - Food Act,No. 26 of 1980 Amended the food (Labelling and Advertising Regulations 2022)
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to food labelling and advertising regulations made under the Food Act, No. 26 of 1980. It establishes new regulatory requirements for food products, including mandatory labelling specifications, ingredient declarations, and compliance standards. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
